name: Chronoromancer
source:
An AI named VOID wants to erase all of existence—and the only person who can stop it is some unemployed dude with no skills, no plan, no game, and no idea what's happening. You.

Travel between a Medieval kingdom, the modern day, and a dystopian future. Build relationships. Train your stats. Run a brothel. Explore dungeons. Get intimate with dozens of unique characters across centuries of history.

[From [url=https://chronoromancer.itch.io/chronoromancer]itch.io[/url]]
